title: No Two Films at Once: A 409 Instead of a Silent Queue | vitalii.no
description:
There was no way to know how much of a single explainer video actually used, so when two kids asked separate questions within minutes of each other, the pipeline just queued the second one invisibly. A parent typing from Telegram while a kid recorded through the app could start a second render stacking on top of the first, and nobody could tell it had happened until two films showed up at once.

I added a busyNow() check inside supabase/functions/[name]/index.ts that looks at any row still in the queue or processing states before accepting a new request. It's called at every entry point — the Telegram text handler, the voice-upload route, and the app's own submit call — a child, a parent, or Telegram, it doesn't matter which door they come through.

If a film is already in flight, the API now returns a 409 busy with the current stage and ETA instead of creating a row. On the app side, the UI reads that same busy field and swaps the recorder for a card showing the stage and minutes left, so the kid sees why the microphone is gone instead of hitting a silent wall.
